payload.description:
Two account-handling defects in plexus/workers/scoring_job.py:

1. `getattr(item, "accountId", account_key)` (used in both Score.Input metadata and the createScoreResult input) only falls back when the attribute is *absent*. An item whose accountId attribute exists but is None/empty persists None instead of falling back to the account key. Use a falsy-aware fallback: `getattr(item, "accountId", None) or account_key`.

2. A missing PLEXUS_ACCOUNT_KEY environment variable raises ScoringJobError with status 400, but absent server configuration is the server's fault, not the caller's; it should surface as a 5xx.

```gherkin
Feature: Scoring job account handling
  Scenario: Item with empty account ID falls back to the account key
    Given an item whose accountId attribute is present but empty
    When a scoring job persists its result
    Then the persisted result uses the request or environment account key

  Scenario: Missing server account key is a server error
    Given no account key in the request or the environment
    When a scoring request is processed
    Then the API responds with a 5xx status
```
payload.title: Scoring job account-key handling for empty item account IDs and missing server config
